name: remote-access-decoy
description: Emulates SSH 2.0, Telnet and FTP login services to capture credential stuffing and lateral movement attempts. Every login fails.
author: Doppel
documentation: Runs as UID 0 with every capability dropped except NET_BIND_SERVICE (needed for ports below 1024 in host networking; Docker grants added capabilities only to root). Read-only filesystem, no-new-privileges. Passwords are reported as an HMAC with the node's capture key by default (TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE=hash) so the Hub can match planted honeytokens without storing plaintext. The SSH Ed25519 host key is derived deterministically in memory from TS_CAPTURE_KEY and the sensor ID and is never written to disk.

config.name: TS_SSH_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the SSH 2.0 decoy

config.name: TS_SSH_BANNER
config.description: SSH server identification string (must begin with SSH-2.0-)

config.name: TS_SSH_MAX_AUTH_TRIES
config.description: Maximum SSH authentication attempts per connection

config.name: TS_TELNET_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the Telnet decoy

config.name: TS_TELNET_BANNER
config.description: Banner printed before the Telnet login prompt

config.name: TS_FTP_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the FTP decoy

config.name: TS_FTP_BANNER
config.description: Text after the 220 greeting code on FTP connections

config.name: TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE
config.description: hash: HMAC with the node capture key; plain: clear text; none: not captured

config.name: TS_MAX_CONNS
config.description: Concurrent connections across all enabled listeners

config.name: TS_EVENT_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Event rate-limit window in seconds per source (0 = report every attempt)

triggers.name: ssh_login
triggers.description: SSH authentication attempt (password, keyboard-interactive or publickey)

triggers.name: ssh_connection
triggers.description: SSH connection closed without an authentication attempt

triggers.name: telnet_connection
triggers.description: Telnet connection closed without submitting credentials

triggers.name: ftp_connection
triggers.description: FTP connection closed without a login attempt
